faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.subtitle: Clear answers to your questions about voucher operation, security, and activation.
faq.q1: How does the CARD CHECK service work?
faq.a1: CARD CHECK connects securely to the technical interfaces and registers of partner issuers. When you enter your confidential ticket code, the system queries the voucher status (available balance, validity, creation date, activation) without transferring funds or deducting value.
faq.q2: How do I verify or activate a voucher on the platform?
faq.a2: Simple: 1. Click "Activate My Card". 2. Choose your ticket brand in the list (Transcash, PCS, CASHlib, Neosurf...). 3. Enter your code in the secure field (masked by default). 4. Click "Verify authenticity" to receive the diagnostic and official certificate.
faq.q3: Are my personal information and codes protected?
faq.a3: Absolutely. CARD CHECK uses end-to-end SSL/TLS 1.3 encryption with SHA-256 cryptographic hashing. No raw code, PIN, or password is ever stored in plain text. The audit log only maintains a masked fingerprint compliant with PCI-DSS banking standards.
faq.q4: How long does it take to process a request?
faq.a4: Processing is instantaneous and occurs in real time, generally in under 1.5 seconds. Upon submission, our encrypted connectors query the issuer database and generate your compliance receipt without delay.
faq.q5: How do I contact support in case of a problem?
faq.a5: Our technical support team is available 7/7 via the contact form or directly by email at support@cardcheck-platform.com. We handle each request within 24 hours with personalized follow-up.
faq.q6: What should I do if the result shows 'Ticket already used'?
faq.a6: If you just bought this ticket at a retail store and it shows as redeemed, return immediately to the retailer with your printed, timestamped register receipt to assert your rights with the issuer.
faq.q7: How can I protect myself against recharge ticket scams?
faq.a7: Golden rule: never buy recharge tickets to make a payment requested by an unknown third party on the internet (classified ads, social media, lottery winnings). NEVER share your secret code by photo, SMS, or phone.

refundPage.faqQ1: What is the actual timeline to receive my bank transfer?
refundPage.faqA1: Once your file is audited with partner issuer servers (Transcash, PCS, etc.), the SEPA wire transfer order is issued within 24 to 48 business hours. Depending on your bank, funds arrive in 1-2 business days.
refundPage.faqQ2: Are there any deductions on the refunded amount?
refundPage.faqA2: The standard restitution procedure carries no hidden fees on certified unused tickets. The full valid balance is transferred back to the holder's bank account.
refundPage.faqQ3: What happens to my ticket code after the refund request?
refundPage.faqA3: Upon validation of your refund, the voucher is locked on the central registry to prevent subsequent fraudulent use. An official cancellation certificate is emailed to you.
refundPage.faqQ4: Can I cancel my refund application?
refundPage.faqA4: As long as the file status is 'Under Review', you can contact our support with your file reference to suspend the claim and keep your voucher active.

howItWorksPage.title: How does verification work on CARD CHECK?
howItWorksPage.subtitle: Understand the lifecycle of a recharge coupon, issuer register operations, and fraud protection.
howItWorksPage.step1Desc: The customer purchases a recharge at an authorized retailer or online. The ticket features a unique 10, 12, or 16-digit code.

howItWorksPage.scamGuideSubtitle: Be vigilant: recharge tickets are not a payment method between unknown individuals.
howItWorksPage.scamNeverDoDesc: Never send a picture of the voucher with the code visible or part of the code via SMS / WhatsApp to 'prove that you bought the ticket'.
howItWorksPage.scamNeverBelieveDesc: No official body (Police, Tax office, Notaries, Couriers) ever requests payment via Transcash, PCS, or Neosurf coupons.
howItWorksPage.scamGoodReflexDesc: Verify the authenticity of your receipt on CARD CHECK yourself before topping up your personal bank card.
howItWorksPage.scamInDoubtDesc: Safely retain the store register receipt with issuance date and time for any dispute inquiries.

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Find clear answers on voucher verification, fund security, and best practices.
faqPage.q1: Does verification consume or activate the voucher?
faqPage.a1: No. A simple verification merely queries the status in the issuer database. Your balance remains 100% intact as long as you do not activate or redeem it on the official brand service.
faqPage.a2: The operation is near-instantaneous: between 0.8 and 1.8 seconds depending on the issuer gateway response time.
faqPage.q3: Who can see the code I entered?
faqPage.a3: No one. Communication goes through a 256-bit SSL encrypted tunnel. Furthermore, our audit logs apply strict masking (e.g. TR-••••-8491) to guarantee your anonymity and data privacy.
faqPage.q4: A buyer or seller is asking me to send the code, what should I do?
faqPage.a4: Never do so under any circumstance. Anyone possessing the code numbers can debit the voucher in seconds irrevocably. Send only the verification certificate without the code.
faqPage.q5: My Transcash voucher has 12 digits, is this normal?
faqPage.a5: Yes, Transcash Mastercard recharges typically feature 12 digits printed in bold on the receipt issued by retail stores.
faqPage.q6: What is the difference between PCS Mastercard and Neosurf?
faqPage.a6: PCS Mastercard is primarily designed to reload a prepaid Mastercard card. Neosurf is a direct online payment voucher usable across hundreds of merchant and gaming websites.
faqPage.q7: Why does my voucher indicate 'Already used' when I just bought it?
faqPage.a7: This rare case can occur due to a checkout error or if compromised prior to handover. Keep your original receipt and contact the store support with your CARD CHECK certificate.
faqPage.a8: Some issuer servers perform nocturnal maintenance or experience brief traffic peaks. Simply retry in 2 or 3 minutes.
